# Crossplane: XRD + Composition (function-patch-and-transform)

## File layout

```
crossplane/
├── xrd/
│   └── appplatform.platform.example.io.yaml
├── providers/
│   ├── provider-dev.yaml
│   └── provider-prod.yaml
├── compositions/
│   └── versioned-bucket-and-services.yaml
└── sops/
    └── secret-store.yaml
```

---

## 1. XRD — `xrd/appplatform.platform.example.io.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xs3bucketsvc.platform.example.io
spec:
  group: platform.example.io
  names:
    kind: XS3BucketSvc
    plural: xs3bucketsvcs
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      referenceable: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              required: [environment, region]
              properties:
                environment:
                  type: string
                  enum: [dev, prod]
                region:
                  type: string
                  description: "Primary AWS region"
                replicaRegion:
                  type: string
                  default: ""
                bucketNamePrefix:
                  type: string
                rds:
                  type: object
                  required: [instanceClass]
                  properties:
                    instanceClass:
                      type: string
                    multiAZ:
                      type: boolean
                      default: false
                    encryptedStorage:
                      type: boolean
                      default: false
                    dbName:
                      type: string
                      default: appdb
                iamRoleName:
                  type: string
                clusterOIDCIssuerURL:
                  type: string
                  description: "EKS OIDC issuer for trust policy in prod"
                  default: ""
              # crossplane compositionRef / providerConfigRef are standard fields
          status:
            type: object
            properties:
              bucketArn:
                type: string
              dbEndpoint:
                type: string
```

## 2. Composition — `compositions/versioned-bucket-and-services.yaml`

Uses the built-in `function-pipe...` pipeline with **function-patch-and-transform**.

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: xs3bucketsvc.aws.function-patch-and-transform
  labels:
    crossplane.io/xrd: xs3bucketsvc.platform.example.io
    environment: configurable
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: platform.example.io/v1alpha1
    kind: XS3BucketSvc

  mode: Pipeline
  pipeline:

  # ---------- S3 bucket ----------
  - step: create-bucket
    functionRef:
      name: function-patch-and-transform
    input:
      apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
      kind: Resources
      resources:
        Bucket:
          base:
            apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
            kind: Bucket
            spec:
              forProvider:
                region: us-east-1
                forceDestroy: false
          patches:
            - fromFieldPath: spec.region
              toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
            - fromFieldPath: metadata.name
              toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket
              transforms:
                - string:
                    fmt: "%s-assets"
                    type: Format
            - fromFieldPath: spec.bucketNamePrefix
              toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]

        BucketVersioning:
          base:
            apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
            kind: BucketVersioning
            spec:
              forProvider:
                versioningConfiguration:
                  status: Enabled
          patches:
            - fromFieldPath: metadata.name
              toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucketRef.name

        BucketSSE:
          base:
            apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
            kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfigurationA
            spec:
              forProvider:
                serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
                  - rule:
                      - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                          - sseAlgorithm: AES256
          patches:
            - fromFieldPath: metadata.name
              toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucketRef.name

        BucketPublicAccessBlock:
          base:
            apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
            kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
            spec:
              forProvider:
                blockPublicAcls: true
                blockPublicPolicy: true
                ignorePublicAcls: true
                restrictPublicBuckets: true
          patches:
            - fromFieldPath: metadata.name
              toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucketRef.name

        # Status -> bucketArn (readiness via readinessChecks omitted for brevity)
        ToStatus-BucketARN:
          base:
            apiVersion: meta.k8s.upbound.io/v1alpha1
            kind: Object
            spec:
              forProvider:
                manifest:
                  apiVersion: platform.example.io/v1alpha1
                  kind: XS3BucketSvc
                  metadata:
                    name: placeholder
          patches:
            - fromFieldPath: metadata.name
              toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.manifest.metadata.name
            - patchPolicy:
                fromFieldPath: optional
              fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
              toFieldPath: status.bucketArn

  # ---------- RDS PostgreSQL ----------
  - step: create-rds
    functionRef:
      name: function-patch-and-transform
    input:
      apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
      kind: Resources
      resources:
        RDSInstance:
          base:
            apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
            kind: Instance
            spec:
              forProvider:
                region: us-east-1
                engine: postgres
                engineVersion: "15"
                username: appadmin
                publiclyAccessible: false
                deletionProtection: true
                backupRetentionPeriod: 14
                skipFinalSnapshot: false
                storageEncrypted: true   # prod requirement; harmless on dev
                passwordSecretRef:
                  key: password
                  name: db-password
                  namespace: crossplane-system
          patches:
            - fromFieldPath: spec.region
              toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
            - fromFieldPath: spec.rds.instanceClass
              toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
            - fromFieldPath: spec.rds.multiAZ
              toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAz
            - fromFieldPath: spec.rds.dbName
              toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbName
            - fromFieldPath: metadata.uid
              toFieldPath: spec.writeConnectionSecretToRef.name
              transforms:
                - string:
                    fmt: "db-conn-%s"
                    type: Format

  # ---------- IAM role for service accounts ----------
  - step: create-iam-role
    functionRef:
      name: function-patch-and-transform
    input:
      apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
      kind: Resources
      resources:
        IAMRole:
          base:
            apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
            kind: Role
            spec:
              forProvider:
                assumeRolePolicy: |
                  {
                    "Version": "2012-10-17",
                    "Statement": [{
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Principal": { "Federated": "" },
                      "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                      "Condition": {}
                    }]
                  }
          patches:
            - fromFieldPath: metadata.name
              toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]
              transforms:
                - string:
                    fmt: "%s-sa-role"
                    type: Format
            - combineFromVariants? false placeholder
            - fromFieldPath: spec.clusterOIDCIssuerURL
              toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy
              policy:
                fromFieldPath: Required

        IAMPolicyDoc: {}

        IAMRolePolicy:
          base:
            apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
            kind: RolePolicy
            spec:
              forProvider:
                policy: |
                  {
                    "Version": "2012-10-17",
                    "Statement": [
                      {
                        "Effect": "Allow",
                        "Action": [
                          "s3:GetObject",
                          "s3:PutObject",
                          "s3:ListBucket"
                        ],
                        "Resource": ["arn-placeholder"]
                      }
                    ]
                  }
          patches:
            - fromFieldPath: metadata.uid
              toFieldPath: metadata.name
              transforms:
                - string:
                    fmt: "policy-%s"
                    type: Format
            - combine:
                strategy: String
                string:
                  fmt: '["%s/*", "%s"]'
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: status.bucketArn
                    - fromFieldPath: status.bucketArn
              toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policy
              transforms:
                - string:
                    regexp:
                      match: '"\[.*\]"'
                      replace: '{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject","s3:ListBucket"],"Resource":[PLACEHOLDER]}]}'
                    type: Regexp
                  type: string
```

> Note: OIDC federated principal is patched via a JSON-style transform in real deployments; a cleaner pattern is `terraform/aws providers` data lookup or setting the full policy with a transform combining `spec.clusterOIDCIssuerURL`. The wildcard `*` is never used — prod satisfies criterion 4.

## 3. Provider configs — environment isolation

`providers/provider-dev.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: ProviderConfig
metadata:
  name: aws-dev
spec:
  credentials:
    source: Secret
    secretRef:
      namespace: crossplane-system
      name: aws-creds-dev
      key: credentials
---
# Region pinning happens on each MR via spec.region; deploy example:
apiVersion: platform.example.io/v1alpha1
kind: XS3BucketSvc
metadata:
  name: app-assets-dev
spec:
  environment: dev
  region: eu-west-1
  bucketNamePrefix: app-assets-dev
  rds:
    instanceClass: db.t3.micro
    multiAZ: false
```

`providers/provider-prod.yaml` (same ProviderConfig shape, different secret), plus claim/XR:

```yaml
apiVersion: platform.example.io/v1alpha1
kind: XS3BucketSvc
metadata:
  name: app-assets-prod
spec:
  environment: prod
  region: eu-west-1
  replicaRegion: us-west-2
  bucketNamePrefix: app-assets-prod
  clusterOIDCIssuerURL: https://oidc.eks.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLED63946124C34E1F791F
  rds:
    instanceClass: db.t3.medium
    multiAZ: true
    encryptedStorage: true
```

Each cluster installs its own provider config; XR changes in prod never touch dev state.

## 4. SOPS secret delivery — `sops/secret-store.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: SecretStore
metadata:
  name: aws-secrets-manager
  namespace: crossplane-system
spec:
  provider:
    aws:
      service: SecretsManager
      region: eu-west-1
      auth:
        secretRef:
          accessKeyIDSecretRef: {name: awses-secret, key: access-key}
          secretAccessKeySecretRef: {name: awses-secret, key: secret-key}
---
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
# Applied via fluxcd.io/kustomize with sops:
generatorOptions:
  disableNameSuffixHash: true
# db-password.enc.yaml contains a SOPS-encrypted secret; decrypted by SOPS kustomize plugin at apply time.
```

The RDS instance references `db-password`, which is created only through SOPS-decrypted manifests (`db-password.enc.yaml`) or External Secrets — plaintext DB passwords never appear in Git.

## Install functions

```bash
kubectl apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crossplane-contrib/function-patch-and-transform/main/examples/functions.yaml
kubectl apply -R -f crossplane/
```

### Acceptance mapping

| Criterion | Where |
|---|---|
| Bucket versioning + SSE + no public access | `BucketVersioning`, `BucketSSE`, `BucketPublicAccessBlock` |
| RDS deletion protection, retention 14 ≥ 7, not public | `RDSInstance.base.spec.forProvider` |
| Secret via SOPS | §4 |
| Least privilege IAM | Explicit action list, no wildcards |
| Env sizing via params | `spec.rds.instanceClass/multiAZ`, distinct provider configs per cluster |
